contract.userJob: Understand who a person is, what defines them, and why they matter.

layout.wide: Use a focal portrait beside defining facts, followed by supporting sections.
layout.compact: Stack identity, portrait, defining facts, and supporting sections in reading order.

contract.fallback: Preserve the complete sourced profile and omit media when provenance is unavailable.

quality.nextAction: Maintain portrait provenance, opt-out behavior, and web-parity regression coverage.
